stemMd: Why might a viable seed fail to germinate in the described experiment?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every dormant seed was removed before sampling.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The experiment measures only vegetative reproduction.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Visible plants prevent any seed from germinating in a laboratory.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The experimental conditions may not match its requirements.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It must have lost all capacity to grow.

explanationMd: The second paragraph identifies treatment-dependent detection: a viable seed may require a different light, moisture, or temperature combination.

distractorRationale.c: The passage provides no such mechanism.
distractorRationale.b: It is explicitly a seed-germination experiment.
distractorRationale.e: Failure under one treatment does not establish nonviability.
